name: Cinnamon Honey Latte
desc: Espresso poured over a honey and cinnamon paste, topped with steamed milk.

source.title: Honey Cinnamon Latte (hot and iced)
source.evidence: Same drink and method: a double espresso stirred with honey and ground cinnamon in the mug, topped with steamed or frothed milk and a pinch of cinnamon.

ingredients.raw: 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon, plus a pinch for dusting

steps: In the bottom of your mug, stir the honey, 1/4 tsp cinnamon, vanilla and salt into a thick paste. Doing this first keeps the cinnamon from clumping and floating on top later.
Brew the espresso directly into the mug over the paste. Stir for about 15 seconds while it is hottest, until the honey dissolves fully and the cinnamon disperses.
Heat the milk to about 150°F, steaming but not simmering. With a steam wand, aerate for 3 to 4 seconds at the surface, then submerge the tip to build a smooth whirlpool.
No machine: heat the milk in a small saucepan over medium heat and whisk hard, or shake it in a sealed jar for 30 seconds, then microwave uncovered for 30 seconds.
Pour the milk into the mug from a few inches up, then bring the pitcher close at the end to let the foam through. Dust the top with the pinch of cinnamon.
tips: For an iced version, stir the paste and espresso as above, fill the glass with ice, and pour in cold milk.
Champagne Tastes makes a honey cinnamon syrup instead (equal parts honey and water warmed with a cinnamon stick), which keeps a month in the fridge if you make these often.
